name: Deore XT crankset (2000 reference)
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 647 g for the FC-M751 four-arm crankset with 175 mm arms and 44/32/22T chainrings; excludes the separately listed BB-ES70 bottom bracket. This is the 2000 FC-M751 reference, distinct from FC-M750-4; it is not converted into an estimated 170 mm weight.
